大昭承光八百一十三年，古雅斯河、科拉河与路河三条大河奔涌千里，携带着上游的沃土泥沙，在中原腹地冲积出一片沃野万里的平原。这片平原土地膏腴，阡陌纵横，乃是大昭王朝的粮仓命脉，而平原中部、古雅斯河北岸，一座巍峨雄城拔地而起，正是大昭的都城——紫徽城。
紫徽城人口逾六千万，城郭面朝东南，背靠玉龙仙山余脉，气势磅礴。东南城门为正门，主门宽十丈有余，高三丈八尺，门楣之上镌刻着“紫徽城”三字，笔力遒劲，乃紫徽真君亲题。主门两侧各设两座副门，每座副门宽五丈，高二丈五尺，专供寻常百姓与商旅通行。主副五门之外，各矗立着一对通体黝黑的精铁雄狮，狮身由百炼精铁铸就，鬃毛飞扬，双目圆睁，兽牙外露，仿佛在无声地震慑着外来之敌。再看那城墙，高达十丈，通体由精铁岩堆砌而成，精铁岩质地坚硬如铁，色泽青灰，历经八百年风雨冲刷，依旧坚不可摧。城墙精铁岩内部布满了肉眼难辨的玄奥阵纹，这些阵纹勾勒在铁岩内，一环扣一环，一脉连一脉，层层叠叠覆盖了整座皇城，乃至城外百里之地。阵纹之中，灵力流转不息，如蛛网般不间断地扫描着城内的异常能量波动，一旦检测到非授权的灵力异动，便会瞬间激活护都屏障——这是大昭王朝在碧霄仙宗的携助下集全国能工巧匠之力，耗时近百年方才建成的护都大阵，名曰“天罗阵”。远远望去，整座紫徽城宛如一头蛰伏在平原之上的上古巨兽，鳞甲森森，气势沉雄，透着一股睥睨天下的压迫感。
自南城门入内，一条宽达三十丈的御道笔直延伸，路面由打磨光滑的精铁岩铺就，平整如镜，光可鉴人，直抵皇城深处的大昭皇庭。
时值午夜，夜色如墨，星子稀疏。皇城内城门紧闭，朱红的城门上镶嵌着鎏金铜钉，每一枚铜钉都重达三斤，钉身铸有符文，在月色下泛着冷冽的光。御道两旁，一排排禁卫军身披玄甲，手持长矛，腰悬佩剑，肃然而立。这些禁卫军皆是从边关百战精锐中挑选而出，每人都练有大昭皇室秘传的“玄武劲”，内力外放时，周身会泛起一层淡淡的玄色罡气。他们身姿挺拔如松，气息沉稳，纵然夜风拂过，衣袂翻飞，却依旧纹丝不动，唯有偶尔闪过的眸光，锐利如鹰隼，警惕地注视着周遭的一切。哪怕是一只飞鸟掠过，他们腰间的佩剑都会微微震颤，发出龙吟般的轻鸣。
皇庭大殿之内，烛火通明，龙涎香的袅袅青烟弥漫在殿宇间。大昭皇身着玄黑龙袍，端坐于九龙宝座之上，面容肃穆，俯瞰着阶下群臣。左侧文臣，身着绯色官袍，手持象牙笏板，垂首而立；右侧武将，身披亮银铠甲，气势凛然。满朝文武皆屏息凝神，偌大的大殿内，竟只闻烛火燃烧的噼啪声，气氛庄严而凝重。
与皇庭大殿的肃穆不同，皇城西侧的皇族庭苑——枫叶苑，苑内却是一片截然不同的光景。
枫叶苑因苑中遍植枫树而得名，此时虽非深秋，却也有几株枫树早早地染上了红霜，在夜色中透着几分萧瑟。这些枫树并非普通树种，而是当年瑞安王游历断天山脉，无意间在悬崖峭壁间发现的“血枫”。此树奇特，树叶落地三年不腐，碾碎入药，能活血化瘀，疗伤续命，即便是寻常人佩戴在身，也能滋养肉身，延年益寿，乃是不可多得的灵木。苑中凉亭内，端坐着一位须发皆白的老者，他身着一身灰白长袍，面容清癯，气韵超然，手中正端着一杯灵茶，茶盏是温润的羊脂白玉所制，茶汤碧绿如玉液，氤氲着淡淡的茶香。他不紧不慢地细细品尝着，眉眼间带着几分悠然，几分淡然。看似随意的坐姿，却有一股无形的仙力自他周身弥漫开来，如一张绵密的大网，以他为中心，悄无声息地笼罩着整座皇城。仙力流转之处，天地灵气愈发浓郁，护都大阵的阵纹也似有感应，微微闪烁着不易察觉的光芒。
凉亭外，廊道两侧，十几个丫鬟垂手侍立，她们皆是精心挑选出来的伶俐人儿，此刻却个个敛声屏气，面色紧张，连呼吸都不敢大声。廊道尽头的主卧房，门窗紧闭，窗纸上糊着一层厚厚的宣纸，隐约可见屋内烛火摇曳，人影绰绰。
房门外，一名年约四十的中年男子正焦虑地来回踱步。他身着锦缎王袍，腰束玉带，面容俊朗，眉宇间却满是焦灼。此人正是当今圣上的族弟，封号“瑞安王”。他不时抬手，想要叩响房门，却又硬生生忍住，他抬眼望向凉亭中的老者，见老者依旧气定神闲地品茶，眉宇间的焦灼方才稍稍褪去几分，心中多了些许安然。可那份为人夫、为人父的担忧，终究是压不住，他又转过身，一遍遍低声询问守在门口的嬷嬷：“里面怎么样了？王妃她……她还好吗？
嬷嬷亦是满脸忧色，却还是强作镇定地劝慰：“王爷莫急，王妃吉人天相，母子定能平安顺遂。”
话音未落，一阵凉风穿廊而过，卷起几片落叶，沙沙作响。就在这时，卧房内忽然传出一声清亮的婴儿啼哭，那哭声清脆响亮，穿透了紧闭的门窗，响彻整个秋叶苑的夜空。
瑞安王猛地僵住脚步，浑身一震，脸上的焦灼瞬间被狂喜取代。
几乎是同时，卧房的门“吱呀”一声被推开，一位年约四十的稳婆快步走了出来，她满脸喜色，额头上还挂着细密的汗珠，一见到瑞安王，便激动得声音发颤，连连躬身道：“王爷！王爷大喜！大喜啊！王妃母子平安，喜得一位公子！”
“母子平安……喜得公子……”瑞安王喃喃重复着这几句话，眼中瞬间迸发出耀眼的光芒，他再也按捺不住心中的狂喜，手舞足蹈起来，竟连平日里的儒雅风范都顾不上了。他原地转了两圈，随即放声大笑：“好！好！母子平安就好！”
廊道两侧的丫鬟们也松了口气，纷纷面露喜色，齐齐躬身行礼，脆生生地喊道：“恭喜王爷！贺喜王爷！”
瑞安王大手一挥，朗声道：“今日乃本王大喜之日！苑中所有人，本王都重重有赏！每人赏银十两，锦缎两匹！”
“谢王爷恩典！”众人欢声雷动，喜悦之情溢于言表。
瑞安王此刻早已心急如焚，他三步并作两步，大步流星地来到卧房门前，小心翼翼地推开房门。房内弥漫着淡淡的药香与血腥气，王妃斜倚在床头，面色苍白，嘴唇干裂，却难掩眉宇间的温柔笑意。她的身旁，襁褓之中躺着一个小小的婴儿，眉眼尚未长开，眼睛微微闭着，长长的睫毛像两把小扇子，小巧的鼻子微微翕动，模样惹人怜爱。
瑞安王放轻了脚步，生怕惊扰了床上的母子，他缓步走到床边，目光落在王妃脸上，声音温柔得能滴出水来：“辛苦你了，爱妃。”

王妃虚弱地摇了摇头，抬手指了指襁褓中的婴儿，嘴角扬起一抹幸福的笑意。
瑞安王的目光落在孩子身上，心中涌起一股难以言喻的柔软。他伸出手想要触碰那娇嫩的小脸，指尖悬在半空却又猛地停住，生怕自己粗糙的手掌弄疼这脆弱的小生命。犹豫片刻，他才小心翼翼地伸出一根手指，轻轻碰了碰婴儿的脸颊。温热柔软的触感传来，细腻如上好的丝绸，一股暖流瞬间从指尖蔓延至四肢百骸，他眼眶一热，泪水险些夺眶而出。就在这时，婴儿似乎感受到了他的触碰，小嘴微微动了动，发出一声软糯的咿呀声，小小的手掌握成拳头，紧紧攥住了他的手指。那力道微弱，却攥得瑞安王心头一颤，只觉这小小的拳头，攥住的是他往后余生的牵挂。
窗外，夜色渐淡，天边隐隐泛起了一抹鱼肚白。一缕晨曦穿透云层，恰好落在那襁褓中的婴儿脸上，映得那小小的脸庞，愈发显得玉雪可爱。
而此刻的皇庭大殿之上，一道喜报传来，打破了殿内的沉寂。
“瑞安王府喜得麟儿！母子平安！”
大昭皇听闻此讯，紧绷的面容骤然舒展，他猛地站起身，朗笑道：“好！好！朕的皇侄降世，实乃我大昭之祥瑞！传朕旨意，赐瑞安王世子黄金百两，锦缎千匹。”
“吾皇万岁万岁万万岁！”
满朝文武齐齐躬身行礼，山呼万岁。大昭皇爽朗一笑，抬手道：“今夜辛苦各位爱卿了，时辰不早，诸位都回府歇息吧，有什么朝政，次日再议！”
晨光刺破夜雾，如潮水般洒遍紫徽城的大街小巷。这座沉睡的雄城缓缓苏醒，街道上渐渐有了人声，早点摊的炊烟袅袅升起，卖包子的吆喝声、打铁铺的锤声、茶馆里的说书声交织成一片热闹的市井烟火。一桩关乎皇朝血脉的喜事，正随着拂面的晨风，传遍了都城的每一个角落。

In the 813th year of Emperor Chengguang's reign, the three great rivers Guyas River, Kola River and Lu River surged thousands of miles, carrying fertile soil and sand from the upper reaches, and alluvialized a fertile plain thousands of miles away in the hinterland of the Central Plains. This plain, with its fertile land and crisscrossed roads, was the lifeblood of the Jokhang Dynasty. In the middle of the plain, on the north bank of the Guyas River, a majestic city rose from the ground. It was the capital of the Jokhang Dynasty, Zihui City.
Zihui City has a population of more than 60 million. The city walls face southeast and are backed by the remnants of the Jade Dragon Mountain. It is majestic. The southeast gate is the main gate. The main gate is more than ten feet wide and three feet eight feet high. The three characters "Zi Hui City" are engraved on the lintel of the gate. The words "Zi Hui City" are written with strong penmanship and are inscribed by the true king of Zi Hui. There are two auxiliary gates on each side of the main gate. Each auxiliary gate is five feet wide and two feet five feet high, which is specially designed for ordinary people and business travelers to pass. Outside the main and auxiliary gates, each stands a pair of black fine iron lions. The lion's body is made of hundreds of refined iron, its mane is flying, its eyes are wide open, and its teeth are exposed, as if it is silently frightening foreign enemies. Look at the city wall, which is ten feet high and is made entirely of fine iron rock. The fine iron rock is as hard as iron and blue-gray in color. It has been washed away by wind and rain for eight hundred years and is still indestructible. The interior of the fine iron rock of the city wall is covered with mysterious formations that are difficult to discern with the naked eye. These formations are outlined in the iron rock, one link after another, one vein after another, covering the entire imperial city and even hundreds of miles outside the city. Within the formations, spiritual power circulates continuously, scanning the city for abnormal energy fluctuations like a spider web. Once unauthorized spiritual power changes are detected, the capital protection barrier will be activated instantly. This is the capital protection formation of the Jozhao Dynasty, with the help of the Bixiao Immortal Sect, which gathered the power of skilled craftsmen from all over the country and took nearly a hundred years to build. It is called the "Tianluo Formation". Looking from a distance, the entire Zihui City looks like an ancient giant beast dormant on the plain, with dense scales and majestic momentum, giving off a sense of oppression that looks down on the world.
Entering from the south city gate, a thirty-foot-wide royal road stretches straight. The road is paved with smooth polished fine iron rock, as flat as a mirror, and can be seen in light, until it reaches the Jokhang Imperial Courtyard deep in the imperial city.
It was midnight, the night was as dark as ink, and the stars were sparse. The gates in the imperial city were tightly closed, and the vermilion gates were inlaid with gilt copper nails. Each copper nail weighed three kilograms, and the body of the nails was cast with runes, glowing coldly under the moonlight. On both sides of the royal road, rows of imperial guards stood solemnly wearing black armor, holding spears and swords hanging from their waists. These imperial guards are all selected from the elites of hundreds of battles at the border. Each of them has practiced the "Xuanwu Jin" secretly passed down by the Jokhang royal family. When the internal strength is released, a faint black aura will appear all over the body. Their postures were as tall and straight as pine trees, and their breaths were calm. Even though the night wind blew and their clothes were flying, they remained motionless. Only the occasional flash of eyes, sharp as eagles, watched everything around them vigilantly. Even if a bird flies by, the swords on their waists will tremble slightly and make a soft cry like a dragon's roar.
In the main hall of the imperial court, the candles were brightly lit, and the green smoke of ambergris filled the hall. Emperor Zhaozhao was dressed in a black dragon robe, sitting on the Nine Dragon Throne, with a solemn face, overlooking the ministers below. The civil servants on the left are wearing crimson official robes and holding ivory wat tablets, standing with their heads bowed; the generals on the right are wearing bright silver armor and look majestic. All the civil and military officials in the court were holding their breath and concentrating. In the huge hall, only the crackling sound of candles could be heard, and the atmosphere was solemn and solemn.
Different from the solemnity of the Imperial Palace, the Maple Leaf Garden, the royal garden on the west side of the imperial city, has a completely different scene.
Maple Leaf Garden got its name from the maple trees planted all over the garden. Although it was not late autumn at this time, there were still several maple trees that were stained with red frost early, looking a bit bleak in the night. These maples are not ordinary tree species, but the "blood maples" that King Ruian accidentally discovered among the cliffs when he visited the Duantian Mountains. This tree is unique. Its leaves do not rot for three years after falling to the ground. They can be crushed and used as medicine. They can activate blood circulation and remove blood stasis, heal injuries and prolong life, even for ordinary people.Wearing it on the body can also nourish the physical body and prolong life. It is a rare spiritual tree. In the pavilion in the garden, there is an old man with white beard and hair sitting. He is wearing a gray-white robe, with a pale face and a transcendent charm. He is holding a cup of spiritual tea in his hand. The tea cup is made of warm mutton-fat white jade. The tea soup is as green as jade liquid, and is filled with a faint fragrance of tea. He tasted it slowly and carefully, with a bit of leisure and a bit of indifference in his eyebrows. Although he seemed to be sitting casually, there was an invisible celestial power spreading from his body, like a dense net, with him as the center, silently covering the entire imperial city. Where the immortal power flows, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth becomes more and more intense, and the patterns of the capital formation also seem to be responsive, flickering with an imperceptible light.
Outside the pavilion, on both sides of the corridor, more than a dozen maids were standing with their hands down. They were all carefully selected smart people, but at this moment, they all kept their voices and held their breath, their faces were nervous, and they did not even dare to breathe loudly. In the master bedroom at the end of the corridor, the doors and windows are closed, and the window paper is covered with a thick layer of rice paper. Candlelight flickering inside the room can be vaguely seen, and figures of people are vaguely visible.
Outside the door, a middle-aged man in his forties was pacing back and forth anxiously. He was wearing a brocade royal robe and a jade belt around his waist. He had a handsome face, but his brows were full of anxiety. This person is the younger brother of the current emperor, and he is titled "King Ruian". He raised his hand from time to time, wanting to knock on the door, but he held it back. He raised his eyes and looked at the old man in the pavilion, and saw that the old man was still calmly sipping tea. The anxiety in his brows had just faded a little, and he felt a little more at ease in his heart. But the worries of being a husband and a father could not be suppressed after all. He turned around again and asked the nanny guarding the door in a low voice over and over: "How is it inside? Princess...is she okay?"
Grandma also had a worried look on her face, but she still managed to calmly comfort her: "My lord, don't be anxious, the princess is a lucky star, and mother and son will be safe and sound. "
Before he finished speaking, a gust of cool wind passed through the corridor, picking up a few fallen leaves and making a rustling sound. At this moment, a clear baby cry suddenly came from the bedroom. The cry was clear and loud, penetrating the closed doors and windows, and resounding throughout the night sky of Qiuye Garden.
King Ruian suddenly froze and his whole body was shaken. The anxiety on his face was instantly replaced by ecstasy.
Almost at the same time, the bedroom door creaked open, and a Wen woman about forty years old walked out quickly. Her face was full of joy, and there were beads of sweat hanging on her forehead. When she saw King Ruian, her voice trembled with excitement, and she bowed repeatedly: "Your Majesty! The prince is overjoyed! What a joy! The princess, mother and son are safe and happy to have a son! "
"Mother and son are safe... I'm so happy to have a son..." King Ruian muttered and repeated these words, his eyes suddenly burst out with dazzling light. He could no longer suppress the ecstasy in his heart and started dancing, not even caring about his usual elegant demeanor. He spun around twice and then laughed loudly: "Okay! good! I hope mother and son are safe! "
The maids on both sides of the corridor also breathed a sigh of relief, looked happy, bowed in unison, and shouted crisply: "Congratulations, Your Majesty! Congratulations, Your Majesty! "
King Ruian waved his hand and said loudly: "Today is my happy day! Everyone in the garden will be greatly rewarded by this king! Each person will be rewarded with ten taels of silver and two pieces of brocade! "
"Thank you, Your Majesty! "The crowd roared with joy, and their joy was beyond words.
King Ruian was already anxious at this moment. He took three steps and two steps at a time, strode to the bedroom door, and carefully opened the door. The room was filled with the faint smell of medicine and blood. The princess was leaning on the bed, her face was pale and her lips were chapped, but she could not hide the gentle smile between her brows. Next to her, there was a tiny baby lying in swaddling clothes. His eyebrows had not yet grown, his eyes were slightly closed, his long eyelashes were like two small fans, and his small nose was slightly twitching. He looked endearing.
King Ruian walked lightly, for fear of disturbing the mother and son on the bed. He walked slowly to the bed and looked down.On the princess's face, the voice was so gentle that it could drip water: "Thank you for your hard work, my dear concubine."
The princess shook her head weakly, raised her finger and pointed at the swaddled baby, with a happy smile on her lips.
King Ruian's eyes fell on the child, and an indescribable softness surged in his heart. He stretched out his hand to touch the delicate little face, but his fingertips were suspended in mid-air but stopped abruptly, for fear that his rough palm would hurt this fragile little life. After hesitating for a moment, he carefully stretched out a finger and gently touched the baby's cheek. A warm and soft touch came, as fine as the finest silk, and a warmth instantly spread from his fingertips to his limbs. His eyes felt hot and tears almost came out of his eyes. At this moment, the baby seemed to feel his touch, its little mouth moved slightly, and it made a soft babbling sound. Its small hands turned into fists and clenched his fingers tightly. The force was weak, but it made King Ruian's heart tremble. He felt that this small fist was holding his worries for the rest of his life.
Outside the window, the night was gradually fading, and there was a faint hint of fish belly white on the horizon. A ray of morning light penetrated the clouds and fell on the face of the swaddled baby, making the little face look even more lovely.
At this moment, in the Imperial Palace, a piece of good news came, breaking the silence in the palace.
"Prince Ruian's Palace is happy to have Lin'er! Mother and son are safe!"
After hearing the news, Emperor Jokhang's tense face suddenly relaxed. He stood up suddenly and said with a loud smile: "Okay! Okay! The birth of my emperor's nephew is really the auspiciousness of Jokhang! According to my will, Prince Ruian will be given a hundred taels of gold and a thousand pieces of brocade."
"Long live my emperor! Long live!"
All the civil and military officials in the court bowed and saluted, shouting long live the mountain. Emperor Zhaozhao smiled heartily, raised his hand and said: "Thank you for your hard work tonight, dear friends. It's getting late, so you all should go back to your homes and rest. If there is any government affairs, we will discuss it the next day!"
The morning light pierced the night fog and spread like a tide throughout the streets and alleys of Zihuicheng. This sleeping majestic city is slowly waking up, and there are gradually people's voices on the streets. The smoke from the early breakfast stalls is rising, the shouts of the bun sellers, the hammers of the blacksmiths, and the sound of storytellers in the teahouses interweave into a lively market fireworks. A happy event related to the blood of the dynasty was spreading to every corner of the capital with the morning breeze.
